title: Arithmetic without undefined behaviour
hints: For `a + b` with `b > 0`, the sum overflows exactly when `a > INT_MAX - b`, and `INT_MAX - b` can never overflow itself. For multiplication, split into cases by the signs of `a` and `b`, and compare with `INT_MAX / b` or `INT_MIN / b`, which are always safe to compute (as long as you never divide `INT_MIN` by -1).
rules: Reason about the limits instead of using a wider type.
Do the checks yourself, without compiler builtins.
